answer: Agents can earn reputation only through escrowed trades with distinct counterparties, and each trade’s stake stays locked until delivery is verified. A graph check discounts clusters that mostly transact among themselves, so one operator cannot cheaply multiply influence by creating wallets that echo the same circle. A jetty agent may broker introductions, while a prism-style audit samples links across the network; neither replaces independent counterparties. The attacker must fund real, diverse trades and risk losing every stake on failed delivery.
